_source: Example brand for demonstration. Replace every value with your own.
author: The Field Notes team

cta.label: Read more →
cta._note: Set enabled=true and url once there's a page to link to

font_stack: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

semantic_colors._rule: One meaning each. Never use as decoration.

voice.summary: A well-read colleague explaining something clearly.
voice.casing: Title Case for products, sentence case for buttons, UPPERCASE for eyebrows
voice.glyphs: → for CTAs, ✓ / ✕ for answers, · between metadata

do: Use red only for the one main action and key emphasis.
Keep the top nav ink (#0F0F1A) in every mode.
Stay flat: borders and ink surfaces, not shadows.
Pair every correct/wrong colour with ✓ or ✕.
Keep touch targets at 44px or more.
dont: Never use blue, purple, indigo, teal, violet, fuchsia or pink.
Don't add icon libraries; emoji on a pastel tile are the icon system.
Don't set body text in gray-400 (#9CA3AF) — captions only.
Don't recolour, stretch or redraw the logo.
Don't use semantic colours as decoration.

image_style: Flat, minimal editorial illustration. Strict colour palette: ink black #0F0F1A, brand red #DC2626, white, and light greys #F9FAFB / #E5E7EB only. No other colours at all — no blue, purple, teal, green or pink. Clean geometric shapes, generous negative space, flat fills, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no texture, no photorealism. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.

defaults.tone: a well-read colleague: direct, warm, precise, short sentences, second person
